info.name: B2B Mediation Platform API (Laravel 12 + JWT)
info.description:
## How to use
- Set collection variables:
  - `base_url` (example: `http://127.0.0.1:8001`)
  - `admin_token` (paste from Admin Login response: `data.token`)
  - `store_token` (paste from Store Login/Register response: `data.token`)

## Important
- **All create/update operations in this collection use `form-data`** as requested.
- For array fields (like `items`), we send them as a **JSON string** inside form-data.

## Response shape
All APIs return JSON in this shape:
```json
{ "data": ..., "message": "...", "errors": null }
```
On errors, you may also receive: `error_code` + `request_id`.

request.description: Login as admin. Copy `data.token` into collection variable `admin_token`.
Register store account. Copy `data.token` into collection variable `store_token`.
Login as store. Copy `data.token` into collection variable `store_token`.

formdata.description: Optional. Image file (max 5MB). Stored in media collection `image`.

JSON array string of category IDs. Example: `[1,2,3]`.
Note: Backend expects an array. If your Postman supports it, you can also send multiple keys like `category_ids[]`.

query.description: Optional filter (legacy in master products; supplier-product is the real offer).

formdata.description: Required. Used to validate category belongs to supplier (pivot). In multi-supplier model, offers are added via `supplier-products`.
Required. Must be assigned to supplier.
Required. (Master price) — real supplier pricing is in `supplier-products.buy_price`.
Optional. (Master stock) — real supplier stock is in `supplier-products.stock_quantity`.

item.name: Admin - Supplier Products (Offers)
item.description:
This is the **multi-supplier** layer. Each record is a supplier offer for a master product.
Fields: `supplier_id`, `product_id`, `buy_price`, `stock_quantity`, `status`.

formdata.description: Required. Purchase cost from this supplier.

request.description: Creates (or updates) the offer for (supplier_id, product_id).
Update supplier offer fields for a specific supplier-product record.

item.name: Store - Catalog
item.description: Store selects supplier offers into its catalog (`store_products`). Each catalog item can override `sell_price` and `is_active`.

formdata.description: Optional. If empty, sales must provide unit_sell_price per item.

item.name: Store - Purchases (Orders to Suppliers)
item.description: Store creates purchase orders using **supplier offers** (`supplier_product_id`). If items belong to multiple suppliers, backend creates **multiple orders** automatically (1 per supplier).

formdata.description:
Required. JSON array string.
Each item: { supplier_product_id (int), quantity (int>=1) }.
If supplier_product_id belong to multiple suppliers, multiple orders will be created.

request.description: Allowed only when status = `submitted`. Restores stock and writes a credit ledger entry.

item.name: Store - Sales
item.description:
Store creates sales orders using catalog items (`store_product_id`). Sell price can be taken from catalog `sell_price` or passed per item as `unit_sell_price`.
Status flow: `draft` -> (pay) -> `paid`.
Cancel allowed only when not paid.

formdata.description:
Optional. JSON object string. If provided, a customer record will be created for this store.
Example: {"name":"A","phone":"...","email":"...","address":"..."}
Optional. Use existing customer id instead of creating new.

Required. JSON array string.
Each item: { store_product_id (int), quantity (int>=1), unit_sell_price (optional) }.
If unit_sell_price omitted, catalog sell_price must exist.
Optional date/time. If empty uses now().
